description: Issue #58 (PROPOSED, not yet finalized): when `trials`, `successes` and a non-null `score` are all present, `score` MUST equal successes / trials (within a 1e-6 floating-point tolerance). Here 1/5 = 0.2 but the producer wrote 0.5 -- a plausible-looking number that contradicts its own denominator, the 'looks complete and is not' failure mode @sattyamjjain described. Note for implementers: like SUCCESSES_EXCEED_TRIALS, this is arithmetic over sibling fields that plain JSON Schema cannot express, so spec/schemas/resultset.json accepts this document and only the hand-rolled SDK validators reject it (code RATE_SCORE_MISMATCH at the `score` path). A conformance implementation MUST perform this same check itself. A conforming validator MUST REJECT this document.
